svg.title: The rig: SO-101 arm with the scanner head
svg.desc: Side view of the setup. An SO-101 arm holds the scanner head above a potted plant on an AprilTag board. A scan mirror on the head sweeps a line of light across the plant, an RGB camera on the head sees the tags, halogen lamps light the scene, and a Jetson Nano and an ESP32 sit on the table. A faded second arm pose shows the next viewpoint. An inset shows the head's internals.
svg.text: The arm carries the scanner to a viewpoint and holds still.
A mirror then sweeps the slit across the object, one line per frame.
